instruction: Please adjust the system volume to 50 percent.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

result.command:
pulseaudio --start
pactl list sinks | grep '^[[:space:]]Volume:' | head -n 1 | awk '{print $5}' | sed 's/%//g'

metadata.explanation: Task requires adjusting system volume to 50%. Evaluator uses existing exact_match metric with vm_command_line getter to verify PulseAudio volume is set to 50%. This is a simple system setting change similar to the original task but with a different target volume.
